tagline: Picture lotería: 144 cards called in Spanish and English; 54 are also available in Nahuatl, Maya and Quechua.
joinInvalid: The code has 5 letters or numbers (no I, L, O, 0 or 1).
joinHelp: Type the 5-character code shown on the cantor's screen.
languagesIntro: Spanish and English calls cover all 144 cards. Nahuatl, Yucatec Maya and Quechua are available for the original 54 cards. See the credits for the provenance of names and voices.

one.title: The room opens
one.body: Each person receives a board in the size selected for the room.

two.title: A card is called
two.body: Each card is called once. Pick its spelling from three choices in your language. The first correct answer earns 2 points; other correct answers earn 1. When the call closes, the card is crossed off automatically on boards that contain it and its name appears.

three.title: A board is completed
three.body: The room detects completed boards automatically. If several people complete theirs, points break the tie.

inclusion.paper: Paper boards are available separately under “Print boards”.
inclusion.access: Adjustable text size, high contrast and keyboard controls.
inclusion.private: No accounts. Your name is shared with people in your room.
inclusion.offline: Solo play and printable boards work offline after the first visit.

audience.classroom: Classrooms and community centres: one screen calls and each person plays on a phone.
audience.family: Multilingual families: grandparents call in their own language while the young ones find the pictures.
audience.heritage: People learning a heritage language: hear each word and choose its spelling.

devNotice: This version combines illustrations and emoji. Indigenous names include drafts whose references still need verification; voices are synthetic. See the credits.
privacyLine: No accounts or tracking cookies. Your name and answers are shared within the room.
nameHint: Only people in your room see it.
nameRequired: Type your name to create a room.
createHint: You organise, the automatic voice calls
scanHelp: Open your phone's camera and point it at the room's QR: it brings you straight here.
footerLine: No accounts, no money. Just little beans.
h1: Lotería de los Pueblos — 144 cards and five language options
lede: A picture lotería for families and classrooms: a voice calls each card and you pick how it is spelled. Join from your phone with a QR code. Free, with no accounts.

how.a: Each person receives a board in the size selected for the room. Each card is called once. Pick its spelling from three choices in your language. The first correct answer earns 2 points; other correct answers earn 1. When the call closes, the card is crossed off automatically on boards that contain it and its name appears. The room detects completed boards automatically. If several people complete theirs, points break the tie.

langs.a: Calls are available in Nahuatl, Yucatec Maya, Quechua (Cusco-Collao), Spanish or English. The full 144-card deck has Spanish and English calls; the original 54 cards are also available in the other three languages. Each player chooses the language they hear and the app language (Spanish or English). During a round, the call language can be changed among languages that cover every card in that room.

free.a: Yes. No accounts or ads. Spanish and English voices use Kokoro-82M; Indigenous-language voices use Meta MMS-TTS (CC BY-NC 4.0), for non-commercial use.

who.a: For multilingual families, classrooms and community centres, and anyone learning a heritage language. Up to 20 people play in one room, and you can also play solo against the computer or print boards to play on paper.
